voice: espeak-ng + MBROLA us2, rate 150, pitch 38, word gap 3

lines.text: This is an emergency broadcast. This is not a test.
lines.beat_before: cold open: late show, signal break, attention tone

lines.text: Tonight, at ten forty two, P.M., the Moon will rise as normal.
Close your curtains now. Cover any windows facing east. If you are outside, keep your eyes on the ground, and go indoors.
Do not take photographs. Do not use binoculars, or telescopes. Do not watch it on a screen.
If someone in your home has already looked, do not let them describe what they saw.
Do not answer, if they say it looks different.
lines.beat_before: father in the yard, staring east

lines.text: Do not answer, if they say it is closer.
The real Moon will rise, in approximately four hours. Until then, stay inside. Stay quiet. And keep listening to this channel, for further instructions.
If this message is coming from outside your window,
lines.beat_before: father now behind the couch; TV dies

lines.text: do not open the curtains to check.
